headline: AI doubles its own R&D while agents learn to dream
summary: Friday moved the week’s center. A METR deep-access read says Anthropic’s capabilities progress roughly doubled over the past year, mostly because AI is automating AI R&D. The same day Anthropic told builders agents should “dream” offline—replay transcripts, build wiki memory, inject a header into every new session—while Claude Code cloud sessions started wiring deps and secrets themselves. Cyber did not cool: GPT-6 Cyber hit Critical preparedness, DeepMind agents found legacy RSA-1024 weaknesses, and labs floated a shared jailbreak severity scorecard. Cursor’s agents already publish past localhost, and Perplexity runs thousands of internal Teammates. Treat the compounding clock as real: know your cyber tier access, what each agent may remember or publish, and who reviews the loop that trains the next model.
